title: Endangered Wildlife and Plants; Receipt of Recovery Permit Applications
snippet: We, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, invite the public to comment on the following applications for a permit to conduct scientific research to promote conservation or other activities intended to recover and enhance endangered species survival.
